faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Hyderabad is 22nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Theoretical Condensed Matter Physics, Quantum Physics, Quantum Chemistry, Computer Science, or related fields from a recognized institution, with a strong background in programming and numerical studies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 58,000 plus HRA.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Research Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Associate-I position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Associate-I position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: IIT Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 502284.

faq.question: Q10. Can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: Yes, the official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article.
